game: Hot Shots Tennis: Get a Grip
approach: Strict matching decompilation: every source in src/ compiles with the original compiler and, linked at its retail address, reproduces that function's retail bytes exactly, with nothing masked.
notes: Work in progress across EBOOT.BIN and the Sharing Version module; the progress bar comes from the published objdiff report and the README has the current figures. Contains no game data, keys or compilers; Sony SDK reconstructions are not published. Not yet open to outside contributions.
